          EXT - COUNTRYSIDE - BROILING HOT DAY

          Seven men walk in chains under a punishing sun.

                         DJANGO
          How much further?

                         SCHULTZ
          Not far now, my friend.

          CUT TO:

          EXT - MORNING TEXAS LANDSCAPE - SUNRISE

          A wagon rolls across the frozen ground.

                         SCHULTZ
          Sleep while you can.

          INT - SALOON - MORNING

          WE SEE the bartender polishing a glass.

                         BARTENDER
          We don't serve his kind here.

          EXT -- A TENNESSEE LAKE - NIGHT

          Water black as ink.

                         DJANGO
          I never seen a lake this big.

          INT/EXT - STAGECOACH - DAY

          The horses labour up the hill.

                         SCHULTZ
          Hold on tight.

          EXT — SNOWY FOREST - NIGHT

          ANGLE ON the treeline.

                         DJANGO
          They're out there.

          FADE OUT.
